title: Surf Shack
description: Welcome to your tropical paradise! Our charming cabin by the sea offers the perfect blend of relaxation and adventure. Nestled in a serene coastal setting, you'll enjoy stunning ocean views and easy access to some of the best surf beaches in the region. The cabin features cozy interiors, a fully equipped kitchen, and a spacious deck where you can unwind and soak in the breathtaking sunsets. Whether you're here to ride the waves or simply relax by the shore, this is the place for you.

title: Ocean Terrace 202 a 4 min walk to Sandy Beach
description: Located just steps away from one of the most popular beaches in the area, this condo is the perfect vacation spot for those looking for both relaxation and adventure. The unit offers all the comforts and amenities of home, while also being within walking distance to various restaurants, bars, and shops. With three spacious bedrooms and a fully equipped kitchen, this condo can easily accommodate a family or group of friends.The spaceThe property is gated and located on the 2nd floor, providing both privacy and security. The master bedroom has a queen-size bed and a private bathroom, while the second bedroom has a full-size bed and the third bedroom has two twin-size beds, making this condo perfect for families with children. Enjoy your morning coffee or evening drinks on the balcony with partial ocean views.Guests have access to a swimming pool, double parking, generator, and water reserve, ensuring a worry-free stay. There is also WiFi and A/C throughout the unit.Guest accessThis area is known for its fantastic surfing, paddleboarding, horseback riding, scuba diving, and sailing charters. On Sundays, you can visit the Farmer's Market, and on Thursdays, there is an Artwalk, where you can discover local artists and their work.Other things to notePlease note that this is not a hotel, so we ask that you treat the space with respect and report any issues that may arise. While there is no one living on-site 24/7, you can always reach out to us for assistance. Toiletries such as shampoo and soap are not provided, so please come prepared with personal items.

title: Private Balcony Suite with 2 Beds: Ocean Breeze
description: Experience luxury and comfort in this spacious suite with 2 king beds and partial ocean views. Perfect for families or groups of friends, the suite features a living room, private balcony, coffee machine, small fridge, TV, Wi-Fi and A/C. The room is located on the first floor with private balcony on the second floor. The property is a self-catering guesthouse. Please note that this room is pet-friendly and non-smoking. pet fee not included in price.The spaceHi! Welcome to Paradise! Please be aware that this unit is not standalone property. Common areas are shared with other guests staying in other rooms. All rooms have private entrances and bathrooms. Please contact us with any questions or concerns. Property includes 2 pools, 3 buildings, free parking spaces, and Wi-Fi. We have no lifeguards on duty in pool areas. We have pet-friendly (pet fee*) rooms, you may see pets in common areas. We also have closed-circuit security cameras recording 24/7 in common areas for your safety. There are no cameras or audio recordings inside any private space of the unit. We are located in a rural area with fully paved roads, close to the beach, restaurants and other places of interest in a hillside surrounded by many trees and nature. It would be best to have a car rental to enjoy this beautiful town. If you have any questions about your room and/or reservation, please contact us through Airbnb inbox. We have staff on site during daytime hours in case you need assistance. Access to room will be sent through inbox around 3-4pm or as soon as the room is ready for use. Any changes must be processed at least 24 hours before arrival date. We have a non-visitor policy. Only registered guests are allowed to enter room or use facilities. Rooms have a maximum of guests. Please read room description before arrival day. Changes upon arrival are not possible most of the time because we have limited spaces. We check and document rooms before giving access. Expect some natural tear and wear of room. A/C’s must be kept on during your stay to prevent excessive moisture inside room. Cristal windows let in light but cannot be open to prevent damage to A/C and unwanted bugs inside room.Guest accessThe room has a lockbox with the key inside next to its door. The day that you arrive we will be sending you a code to gain access to your room at any time after 3pm. Our check in time is 3pm and check out time is 11:30am. Please review your information as room cannot be changed on arrival date because of # of people, location, number of beds, or preferences. Cancelations, modifications or changes of dates must be done 24 hrs before check in date.Other things to noteInternet may fail during your stay do to power outages and/or repairs being done by the island's electric company. We have a power generator and water tanks that feed all rooms.

title: Puntas Rincon Villa 301 w/private rooftop terrace
description: Welcome to our spectacular Penthouse with a Rooftop Terrace! Enjoy the stunning ocean views from the comfort of your own private oasis. Located just steps away from world-class surfing, this is the perfect vacation destination for adventure seekers and beach lovers alike.The spaceTake a dip in the community infinity pool or relax on the balcony with a drink in hand. The unit also features A/C throughout and plenty of outdoor seating for soaking up the sunshine. Inside, you'll find two spacious bedrooms (with a king and queen bed), a full bathroom, and an outdoor shower for those post-beach rinse offs. The fully equipped kitchen has everything you need to whip up a delicious meal, and the living area comes with cable and WiFi for your entertainment.As a guest, you'll have access to gated entry and community laundry facilities. The property is located in the Puntas neighborhood of Rincon, just above Sandy Beach and within walking distance of surfing, dining, and shopping.Guest accessOur facilities have beautiful landscaped surroundings and free parking. The swimming pool area has a charcoal BBQ grill, outdoor shower and lounge chairs.Other things to notePlease note that only a starter supply of essentials is provided (toilet paper, paper towels, trash bags, dish-washing liquid, and soap), and guests must purchase additional supplies if needed. We want you to enjoy every moment of your stay with us. Book now and experience the ultimate beach vacation!

title: A Romantic Ocean View, Heated Pool & Generator

images.caption: Outdoor shower ceiling cut out for natural rain showers

description: **Casita Azure** is a modern, newly built one-bedroom beach villa in Rincón’s Puntas neighborhood, minutes from world-famous beaches, bars, and restaurants. Enjoy stunning ocean and jungle views, a private heated pool, patio, outdoor shower, BBQ grill, and outdoor dining. With a generator for peace of mind, this luxurious casita is a serene escape immersed in nature—and hard to leave.The spaceCasita Azure is a luxury beach villa featuring a private heated pool, soaring ceilings, and an open-concept design that seamlessly blends indoor and outdoor living with breathtaking ocean views of Aguadilla Bay. Ideal for couples, the home can comfortably accommodate up to three guests.The villa offers one air-conditioned bedroom with a queen bed, a full bathroom, and a refreshing outdoor shower. A fully equipped kitchen, indoor and outdoor dining areas, and a queen sofa bed in the living room complete the space. Additional amenities include Wi-Fi, a smart TV, a gas BBQ grill, and beach essentials such as towels and chairs. Every window is fitted with pull-down blackout curtains to ensure privacy and restful sleep.Grocery stores and shopping are less than five minutes away by car.The property features two separate private casitas. The sister casita, **Casita Bambú**, has the same layout with green color accents. While each casita is fully private, they share a common driveway from the road.Guest accessYou are welcome to enjoy the entire house, private pool, and yard. However, please do not access the roof or any areas clearly marked as prohibited. Kindly be respectful of the privacy and quiet enjoyment of guests staying in the other casita.Other things to noteThe villa is equipped with a backup power generator and a water cistern to provide uninterrupted access to electricity and water. The water heater is high-efficiency and tankless. Please allow a few minutes for it to get warm.Please help us reduce our carbon footprint by being mindful of your energy consumption. Follow energy conservation practices, such as turning off the air conditioner if you are not using it or closing doors while the air conditioner is on. For your security, outdoor security cameras are located at the property's entry access points.The villa has concrete floors, which are slippery when wet. Please dry your feet before entering the villa. You can apply your sunscreen outside of the villa to avoid slippery floors. We also ask that you remove all sunscreen before using the furnishings to prevent stains. There are some Palm trees on the property for your enjoyment. These are trimmed frequently, but if not, please do not step under them and beware of falling coconuts. During your visit, you may encounter some of the Caribbean wildlife that inhabits our area. You may hear coquis frogs, roosters, and horses, and may receive visits from iguanas, as well as some of the neighborhood cats and dogs.There are also many opportunities to observe birds like Venezuelan troupials, red-tail hawks, Puerto Rican parrots, and grey kingbirds. We reserve the right to cancel/limit bookings based on the number of nights during Holiday weeks/weekends (3-5 days) Exceptions to the rule applyWe are situated at the westernmost point of the island. We are 2.5 hours from the San Juan (SJU) Airport, 30 minutes from both Aguadilla (BQN) & Mayaguez (MAZ) airports, and 1.5 hours from Ponce (PSE) Airport.. To avoid the drive from San Juan, there is a Cape Air flight that goes directly multiple times a day from SJU to MAZ.
